about_the_game:
Welcome to "Rastignac: Wastelands", a gripping survival horror experience that plunges you into a desolate urban city invaded by hostile aliens.
As the last survivor in town, you must navigate through the chaos of a quarantined zone, where every corner hides new threats and terrifying encounters.

In "Rastignac: Wastelands", you'll face relentless alien hordes driven by an unknown purpose, scavenge for scarce resources to stay alive, and strategize your escape amidst the ruins of the city. With its immersive atmosphere and heart-pounding gameplay, every decision you make could mean the difference between survival and becoming prey to the extraterrestrial menace.

Key Features:

  • Survive in a post-apocalyptic urban city invaded by aliens.

  • Explore a vast and detailed environment filled with hidden dangers and secrets.

  • Utilize a variety of weapons and tools to resist alien threats and scavenge for supplies.

  • Drive through the city streets in search of safety and salvation, but beware of obstacles and ambushes.

  • Experience a gripping story of survival and desperation as you fight to escape the quarantine zone.

"Rastignac: Wastelands" will test your courage, resourcefulness, and determination as you battle against the odds to survive in a world consumed by darkness. Are you ready to face the horrors that await and prove yourself as the ultimate survivor?
